newsitem.title: ALBANIA: SOCCER-ALBANIA MOVES TOWARDS GETTING REINSTATED BY FIFA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ALBANIA MOVES TOWARDS GETTING REINSTATED BY FIFA.

text.p: Albanian Prime Minister Aleksander Meksi said on Sunday he would propose an annulment of suspensions on various Albanian soccer federation officials in hopes of getting his country reinstated into international soccer.
He is expected to submit his proposal on Monday.

Soccer's governing body FIFA suspended Albania indefinitely after the sports ministry ordered the suspension of Albanian Football Association (AFA) general secretary Eduard Dervishi and dissolved the executive committee.
The suspension of Albania puts their World Cup group nine qualifying match against Northern Ireland on December 14 in jeopardy.

"The Prime Minister will propose to the Council of Ministers (meeting on Monday) an annulment of decisions relating to the suspensions of various soccer federation officials," a statement from the prime minister's office said.
"The government pledges to take the necessary steps to overcome present difficulties so that Albanian soccer can remain on the international map," the statement added.
Meksi appealed to the soccer federation and the state sports secretariat to put aside their differences. He also recommended that new executive committee elections be held in February.
Albanian sports secretary Marjeta Pronjari suspended Dervishi for consistently postponing new executive committee elections, breaking Albania's civil law.
But FIFA said it did not recognise the suspensions and still considered Dervishi and the dissolved executive as their only official contacts in Albania.
